summary.headline: Book more calls that lead with buyer-led discovery and Google Business Profile visibility, and less that drift into generic restaurant/commission framing.
summary.tldr: Baseline booking rate is 50.0% across 10 calls. The biggest coaching takeaway is to stay consultative and prospect-specific early, while avoiding broad restaurant pitch language and commission-fee talk unless the buyer brings it up.

signals.title: Anchor on Google Business Profile visibility
signals.insight: Calls that discuss Google Business Profile or online business visibility book at 100.0%, which is 50.0 points above the 50.0% baseline across 3 calls, so reps should connect the conversation to how the prospect is showing up online and what that means for their growth.

signals.title: Avoid early commission and fee framing
signals.insight: Calls that lean into commission fees book at 0.0%, which is 50.0 points below baseline across 3 calls, so reps should avoid centering price or payout structure too early and instead earn that conversation after the buyer sees relevance.

signals.title: Use buyer-led, consultative pacing
signals.insight: Calls with language like you're looking or you're going book at 100.0%, which is 50.0 points above baseline across 4 calls, so reps should keep the prospect talking about priorities and next steps rather than pushing a rigid pitch.

signals.title: Skip the generic restaurant pitch
signals.insight: Calls that stay in a broad restaurant-ranking or local SEO pitch book at 0.0%, which is 50.0 points below baseline across 3 calls, so reps should tailor discovery to the prospect's actual situation instead of leading with a one-size-fits-all restaurant message.
